programme.title: Creeping Death
programme.desc: Undercover agent Alan Fields hunts a rogue thief who killed his partners to keep the stolen loot.

programme.title: Nevermind
programme.desc: Five people are turned upside down by puzzling and paradoxical happenings. A lawyer with a deplorable habit; a baby sitter struggling with a disturbing new job; an old childhood friend with a murky present; a cook with an unmentionable desire; and a psychologist haunted by a tow truck. Five stories that will lead the protagonists to extreme and unpredictable choices.

programme.title: The Clan
programme.desc: Franco and Dino, two mechanics from Rome, leave for Las Vegas to participate in the Harley-Davidson world meeting. They count on winning the reward provided for participants. But their real big dream is different. It is music. The two of them sing and dance to pieces by Frank Sinatra and Dean Martin without thinking that this could become a profession.

programme.title: Seven Deaths in the Cats Eyes
programme.desc: A castle haunted by vampire legends becomes a slaughterhouse as a mysterious killer strikes.

programme.title: Thieves and Robbers
programme.desc: A playboy who makes a living out of seducing women and stealing their jewellery accidentally witnesses a Mafia murder. He must work together with the man who is constantly trying to catch him, Lt. Alan Parker, in order to save his life.

programme.title: Last Feelings
programme.desc: Diego is a boy with problems. Tartassed at school, he does not find a better climate in his family, harassed as he is by his mother and stepfather who put his younger half-brothers before him. Tired of the situation Diego decides to leave and finds a job at a sports club where he can secretly train in swimming, his great sporting passion. There he also finds a couple of loving friends, older than him, who adopt him almost like a son. However, fate has a bitter sentence in store.

programme.title: Crime of Love
programme.desc: The beautiful Carmela, a girl of Sicilian descent who arrived in the North with her parents, falls in love with the Milanese Nullo, a work colleague. But their relationship must come to terms with the difference in the two's views: he is of anarchist ideas while she is deeply religious.

programme.title: Hell of the living dead
programme.desc: A zombie outbreak turns a remote island into a hellish battleground between the living and undead.

programme.title: Friends will be friends
programme.desc: Alessandro, a 40-year-old widowed pediatrician, lives with his teenage son leading a monotonous existence. Following a phone call from Gigi, an old friend from Brazil, the man sees his own weary stability challenged.
